Saturn.1: Saturn in its own place causes wounds from swords and diseases
Saturn.2: in the second place it takes away honor
Saturn.3: in the third it overcomes sickness and one's enemies and produces status
Saturn.4: in the fourth Saturn destroys good qualities and friendship
Saturn.5: in the fifth it gives sons and money
Saturn.6: in the sixth Saturn produces position and wealth
Saturn.7: in the seventh it causes wandering and destroys one's wife
Saturn.8: in the eighth it produces diseases, the destruction of wealth, and (the appearance of) enemies
Saturn.9: in the ninth Saturn destroys one's means of making money
Saturn.10: in the tenth it takes away (the profit from) one's actions
Saturn.11: in the eleventh Saturn produces success in several pleasures and in wealth
Saturn.12: and in the twelfth wandering and fear

Sun.1: Saturn in the place of the Sun gives happiness, money, joy and pleasure
Sun.3: in the third it destroys honor, beauty, and strength
Sun.4: in the fourth it abets the happiness from one's relatives
Sun.5: in the fifth Saturn produces sickness and anxiety about one's sons
Sun.7: in the seventh it gives happiness and joy from one's wife
Sun.8: in the eighth Saturn destroys disease and confusion
Sun.9: in the ninth Saturn determines the appearance of evil
Sun.10: in the tenth success in one's activities
Sun.11: in the eleventh it causes the acquisition of much good and money
Sun.12: in the twelfth the loss of one's employment

Jupiter.1: Saturn in the place of Jupiter causes delusion
Jupiter.2: in the second it destroys good
Jupiter.3: in the third it produces conflict and quarrels
Jupiter.4: in the fourth loss of one's relatives and anxiety
Jupiter.5: in the fifth it gives sons, possessions, honor, and glory
Jupiter.6: in the sixth it produces fame
Jupiter.7: in the seventh Saturn causes the loss of one's wife and agitation
Jupiter.9: in the ninth Saturn gives distress from one's own servants and from low people
Jupiter.10: in the tenth it destroys beauty
Jupiter.11: in the eleventh it causes the acquisition of hoards ( of money) with little effort
Jupiter.12: and in the twelfth strength in one's body

Venus.1: Saturn in the place of Venus takes away one's beauty and one's wife
Venus.2: in the second it takes away wealth
Venus.3: in the third it gives evils, separation, sorrow, and hatred
Venus.4: in the fourth it causes strife
Venus.5: in the fifth Saturn causes imprisonment or wandering
Venus.6: in the sixth lordship, honor, and wealth
Venus.7: in the seventh anxiety and despondency because of one's wife
Venus.9: in the ninth poverty and wandering
Venus.10: in the tenth Saturn destroys prosperity
Venus.11: and in the eleventh and twelfth it gives position, brilliance, joy, wealth, children, and slaves
Venus.12: and in the eleventh and twelfth it gives position, brilliance, joy, wealth, children, and slaves

Mars.1: Saturn in the place of Mars gives unrighteousness (adharma), quarreling, and disease
Mars.2: in the second Saturn causes loss
Mars.3: in the third the destruction of quarreling and strength
Mars.5: in the fifth the acquisition of authority, sons, and wealth
Mars.6: in the sixth an increase in one's good qualities and lordship
Mars.7: in the seventh Saturn produces quarrels, fatigue, and illness
Mars.8: in the eighth it gives burns and wounds
Mars.9: in the ninth Saturn gives divisions and jealousy
Mars.10: in the tenth success with regard to honor, sons, and wealth
Mars.11: in the eleventh the best profits and acquisitions
Mars.12: and in the twelfth physical pleasure

Mercury.1: Saturn in the place of Mercury causes loss and disease
Mercury.2: in the second bewilderment of the mind
Mercury.3: in the third separation from one's allies
Mercury.4: in the fourth the destruction of friendship and trust
Mercury.5: in the fifth Saturn causes improper conduct of one's sons and confusion
Mercury.6: in the sixth success with respect to one's mind, fame, good qualities, and wealth
Mercury.7: in the seventh Saturn produces the appearance of inauspiciousness in one's speech
Mercury.9: in the ninth Saturn causes success with respect to righteousness (dharma) and money
Mercury.10: in the tenth acquisition through work involving speech and the intellect
Mercury.11: in the eleventh the obtaining of lands and quadrupeds
Mercury.12: and in the twelfth honor and learning

Moon.1: Saturn in the place of the Moon establishes imprisonment, wandering, (injuries from) swords, wind-diseases, poison, fire, enemies, distress, and loss of one's wife, sons, and property
Moon.2: in the second place it causes expense and pain
Moon.3: in the third Saturn gives the destruction of one's enemies, honor, joy, beauty, and many acquisitions
Moon.4: in the fourth it causes the disrespect of one's relatives, the loss of beauty, fear of enemies, and illness
Moon.5: in the fifth Saturn produces the loss of position, business enterprises, sons, and wealth, the hatred of one's relatives, and quarrels
Moon.6: in the sixth it gives the destruction of one's enemies, joy, happiness, and wealth
Moon.7: in the seventh Saturn causes the loss of beauty, fatigue, diseases of the genitals, the death of one's wife and friends, and wandering
Moon.8: in the eighth theft, hunger, bondage, death, misery, and disease
Moon.9: in the ninth Saturn gives illness, wandering, quarrels, fatigue, loss of one's possessions, hunger, and misery
Moon.10: in the tenth it destroys one's lordship, the profits of one's actions, and one's hoards, and produces disease and dishonor
Moon.11: in the eleventh Saturn gives glory, other men's wives, wealth, slaves, possessions, success in business, status, and honor
Moon.12: and in the twelfth it takes away cleverness in one's actions, fame, brilliance, and honor

Ascendant.1: Saturn in the ascendent always causes honor from the rulers of cities, towns, and tribes, (the possession of) metals (lohani), and the acquisition of wealth
Ascendant.2: in the second place it causes infamy and a decrease in one's wealth
Ascendant.3: in the third the destruction of bad things, good profits, success, honor, respect, and health
Ascendant.4: in the fourth place from the ascendent Saturn produces houses, money, friendship with one's relatives, and power
Ascendant.5: in the fifth Saturn causes victory, wealth, prosperity, progeny, sons, and strength
Ascendant.6: in the sixth health, joy, brilliance, the destruction of one's foes, fame, diligence, and power
Ascendant.7: in the seventh Saturn gives the death of one's wife, weariness, exile to a foreign land, and illness
Ascendant.8: in the eighth Saturn gives loss of one's wife, sons, and property, imprisonment, death, and disease
Ascendant.9: in the ninth Saturn causes long wanderings, diseases, bodily confinement by one's enemies, and hatred
Ascendant.10: in the tenth honor, joy in one's actions, position, and prosperity
Ascendant.11: in the eleventh place from the ascendent Saturn gives metals (loha), quadrupeds, and so on, as well as women, grain, slaves, and black garments
Ascendant.12: and in the twelfth it produces poverty, misery, and despair
